recall.minute: Evaluation is hard: many valid answers, many dimensions, saturation, leakage. Perplexity = exp(avg NLL): 2.3 → 10; same tokenizer only; not helpfulness. BLEU: clipped n-gram precisions, geometric mean, brevity penalty exp(1 − r/c); ROUGE-N recall, ROUGE-L LCS; example 5 shared words: P 5/6 = 0.83, R 5/8 = 0.625, F1 0.71, BLEU-2 0.41; reward wording. METEOR: stems/synonyms, F-mean = 10PR/(R + 9P), fragmentation penalty; BERTScore: embedding cosine matching (0.95 vs 0.33 exact). Benchmarks: static, live, arenas with Elo (1500 vs 1500, win → 1516/1484; 400 points ≈ 91%), model-based. Faithfulness: atomic facts (3/4 = 0.75), RAG faithfulness (2/3), answer relevance, context precision/recall; intrinsic vs extrinsic hallucination. LLM-as-a-judge: position (64.8% first), verbosity, self-preference; swap orders, rubrics, calibration. Human evaluation: guidelines, multiple raters, κ. Leakage: n-gram overlap checks, private and dynamic sets.
